about: A Berry Incinerate burns up leaves the party's hand at once, as a knocked-off item does (Pokemon Central, Bruciatutto: the Berry is destroyed): a wild Pokemon caught straight after has none. TryIncinerate emptied the battler's hand alone, so until the next copy the party still held the Berry -- a wild Pokemon was caught with it, and one of the player's own had it back at the battle's end. A level-10 Chansey, whose low Sp. Atk leaves its foe standing, with a Master Ball in the bag (--bag) is taught Incinerate (teach:) against a forced wild level-5 Chansey that knows only Splash, holds an Oran Berry and moves first (set:): its Splash, whose PP the party copy writes, comes before the burn, and nothing of it is copied after. The ball is thrown from the battle's bag at the next prompt (touch:, as in caught_pokemon_keeps_item.json), and in the party the caught Chansey holds nothing; before, it held the Oran Berry. The field's RNG is pinned as in rolls_forced_high.json.
